page: The Microsoft Azure NC24ads_A100_v4 is a high-performance server featuring 24 dedicated AMD EPYC 7V13 cores with a 3.7 GHz clock speed, built on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 220.0 GB of RAM, providing 9.17 GB of memory per core, and includes 1026 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capabilities. Acceleration is driven by a single NVIDIA Ampere A100 GPU with 80 GB of VRAM, running on a Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

In benchmark evaluations, this server demonstrates top-tier performance, placing in the top 10% for LLM inference speeds across small, medium, and large models during both prompt processing and text generation. It also achieves a top-tier Passmark memory score. The platform shows strong performance in stress-ng single-core CPU tests, bzip3 multi-threaded decompression, and Geekbench image processing, while maintaining average performance across standard multi-core CPU, cryptography, and database operations.

The combination of dedicated AMD EPYC processing cores, a high-capacity 80 GB VRAM GPU, and a top-tier memory subsystem provides a highly efficient hardware profile for complex computational tasks. This server is optimized for workloads such as large language model inference, deep learning training, data science pipelines, and memory-intensive database operations.
